lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Protesters gathered in front of City Hall Thursday afternoon to protest comments made by Montreal Mayor Soraya Martinez Ferrada, The Canadian Press reports.

The Manitoba government honoured 16 members of the 435 Transport and Rescue Squadron out of 17 Wing at CFB Winnipeg Thursday for their bravery during the deadly fire at CFB Wainwright, The Canadian Press reports.
Iran accused of carrying out drone attack killing 2 Italians in Kuwait, CBS News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
